adopted_comments: Reject nonfinite, negative and mistyped elapsed times and limits.
A duplicate worker rejection must not replace the original worker result.
State precisely that public source checks belong to the batch clock; worker checks and condition preparation belong to the per-condition clock.
verified: Original H, mapping and four-beta deadline provenance are preserved.
Archived comparison schedules are read only and not reconstructed.
Approval, batch/slot/worker claims and deadlines are matched.
Late or invalid results stop the batch; unstarted conditions remain NOT_RUN.
S7 compares relative responses/slacks, with family/scene/request denominators kept separate.
The 60/1800-second proposal is a cap, not a guarantee that all 28 conditions will finish.
